Book of Quiet Doors

You turn the thin pages, following diagrams whose locks seem almost to breathe.

Rules

ID: item-book-of-quiet-doors. Status: Proposal — special equipment. Form: Tome. Bulk: 1.

Requirements: Scholarship 1; identification required. Action: Main Action; ten minutes of study.

After studying for 10 minutes, gain 1 Boon to your next mundane lock attempt this scene. Further study before using it does not add another Boon from this item. Grants no lock-working permission.

Apply this item’s printed benefit only; it grants no ability or action beyond what it states. No DP purchase; found or bought when the DA makes it available. No special recipe is supplied by owning it.

Equipment index

Market price: 150 coins (special-order benchmark; availability is not guaranteed). Proposal; see @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.a8b099af3500d9f6.JournalEntryPage.cfa94361944ba875]{market rules}.
